title: First run: one way to start
change: The empty Home keeps one call to action, Record a video, with upload and a blank page as text links under it. Search, filter, sort, New folder, the duplicate header buttons and the consent card are gone, and Learn leaves the sidebar. On a phone the bar has two tabs, Pages and Record, and the account sits behind the avatar in the header.
evidence: A new user saw three ways to start, shown twice, plus tools for zero items: 22 controls on desktop. Learn had 0 training video plays in 90 days.
notes: The page title stays Home while the phone tab reads Pages; renaming Home is the audit's later phase. The consent question moves to signup, which this mock does not show. The account footer keeps the real Enter your name state of a new account.
